request.description:
Get the cross reference of all the current assets supported by an entity mapped to Lukka normalized assets.

Response Details

Field Name Data Type Data Type Details Description
entity_name CHARACTER 256 Name of the source entity
entity_code CHARACTER 256 Unique Lukka code (ticker) for the source entity
entity_type CHARACTER 20 Type of service provided by the source entity
entity_asset_code CHARACTER 256 Asset code (ticker) provided by the source entity
entity_asset_name CHARACTER 256 Asset name provided by the source entity
entity_asset_internal_id CHARACTER 256 Internal code provided by the source entity to uniquely identify the asset
entity_withdrawal_fee_asset_code CHARACTER 256 Asset code (ticker) of the fee charged by the source entity when withdrawing the asset
entity_withdrawal_fee_amount NUMERIC Amount of fee charged by the source entity when withdrawing the asset
entity_withdrawal_fee_type CHARACTER 256 Indicates if the withdrawal fee charged is a percentage or unit
lukka_asset_id CHARACTER 11 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the crypto asset. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information
lukka_asset_code CHARACTER 256 Lukka normalized unique asset code (ticker)
lukka_asset_name CHARACTER 256 Lukka's long name for the asset
start_time DATE ISO 8601 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the entity asset was mapped to the Lukka asset
end_time DATE ISO 8601 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the entity stopped supporting the asset; also indicates the time when the entity to Lukka asset mapping was removed

request.description:
Get the cross reference of all the pairs listed by an entity the previous day mapped to Lukka normalized pairs.

Response Details

Field Name Data Type Data Type Details Description
entity_name CHARACTER 256 Name of the source entity
entity_code CHARACTER 256 Unique Lukka code for the source entity
entity_type CHARACTER 20 Type of service provided by the source entity
entity_pair_code CHARACTER 256 Pair code provided by the source entity
entity_asset_one_code CHARACTER 256 Base asset code (ticker) of the pair provided by the source entity
entity_asset_one_name CHARACTER 256 Base asset name of the pair provided by the source entity
entity_asset_one_internal_id CHARACTER 256 Internal code provided by the source entity to uniquely identify the base asset
entity_asset_two_code CHARACTER 256 Counter asset code (ticker) of the pair provided by the source entity
entity_asset_two_name CHARACTER 256 Counter asset name of the pair provided by the source entity
entity_asset_two_internal_id CHARACTER 256 Internal code provided by the source entity to uniquely identify the counter asset
entity_price_precision NUMERIC Fixed number of decimal places to which the price is rounded off by the source entity
entity_quantity_precision NUMERIC Fixed number of decimal places to which the quantity traded is rounded off by the source entity
entity_minimum_tick_size NUMERIC Smallest price increment in which the source entity prices are quoted
entity_minimum_trade_quantity NUMERIC Minimum amount of base asset allowed by the source entity to be traded
entity_trade_fee_asset_code CHARACTER 256 Asset code (ticker) of the fee charged by the source entity when trading
entity_trade_fee_amount NUMERIC Amount of fee charged by the source entity when trading
entity_trade_fee_type CHARACTER 256 Indicates if the trade fee charged is a percentage or unit
lukka_pair_code CHARACTER 256 Lukka normalized unique pair code
lukka_asset_one_id CHARACTER 11 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the base asset. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information
lukka_asset_one_code CHARACTER 256 Lukka normalized unique asset code (ticker) for the base asset
lukka_asset_one_name CHARACTER 256 Lukka's long name for the base asset
lukka_asset_two_id CHARACTER 11 11-character unique Lukka ID (LID) for the counter asset. Please refer to the Lukka ID document for more information
lukka_asset_two_code CHARACTER 256 Lukka normalized unique asset code (ticker) for the counter asset
lukka_asset_two_name CHARACTER 256 Lukka's long name for the counter asset
start_time DATE ISO 8601 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the entity pair was mapped to the Lukka pair
end_time DATE ISO 8601 Timestamp (UTC+0) when the entity stopped supporting the pair; also indicates the time when the entity to Lukka pair mapping was removed
